title: Three pads of one net, two of them joined by a track
how: Pads (1 mm squares) are centred at x = 0, 10 and 20 mm; the track runs from (0, 0) to (10, 0), so its two ends are inside the first two pads:
the copper of net A has two islands, {R1.1, track, R2.1} and {R3.1}; one connection is missing.
